notes.title: Small fix
notes.content: Fixed map resolution fog of war

notes.title: Cool fixes
notes.content: [p]Well, most of the reports were about instability when saving and loading the game, since I had done most of the testing myself without saving and loading, people had problems if they didn't finish the game in one go. Fixed issues some users were experiencing:[/p][list][*][p]Buildings no longer pile up in one place when loading the game[/p][/*][*][p]When loading the game, your newly built ships no longer replace the previous ones[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added the much-requested resolutions: You can now put it in full screen mode or in windowed mode[/p][/*][*][p]Improved translations in some places[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the trading system: There are no longer exploits in some cities that allow you to sell above the purchase price[/p][/*][*][p]There are no longer issues with shared reputation between cities[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the texts on dialogue buttons so they never go off-screen even if they are very long[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the volume sliders; -80dB now mutes the track completely[/p][/*][*][p]Added vertical sync option[/p][/*][*][p]The fast travel button now correctly displays when it is active and when it is not[/p][/*][*][p]On mobile devices, the pause menu can now be accessed without having to backspace (fixes some devices that were closing the game instead of opening the pause menu)[/p][/*][*][p]The Removed some hidden text that appeared behind the date (it was a debug when I was testing the reputation I had left there, haha, only a small "a" was visible behind it; the word was "Reputation: (number)", for those curious).[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Jack Sparrow for #MeToo.[/p][/*][/list][p]That's all the improvements for now! If any bugs persist, let me know.[/p]

notes.title: Sooon updates!
notes.content: [p]Hello Pirates![/p][p]Thanks for your reports on the first version of SeaCret. I'm very happy that overall it's been a pretty good experience for everyone, except for a few bugs that I'll fix soon.[/p][p]My plans for upcoming content updates are:[/p][p]The ability to become a pirate yourself and attack merchant ships.[/p][p]Add exploration to recover shipwrecks (and treasure).[/p][p]I'd like to include these two things in future updates (after I make several fixes).[/p][p]And in the future, I'd like to:[/p][p]Try multiplayer![/p][p]It's something I've never done, so I'll have to do a lot of research.[/p][p]Multiplayer will work so you can play with several friends and set a goal, for example, "first to get a frigate wins," and of course, disable the fast-track timer.[/p][p]I'll release these updates as soon as I finish the Wrixy app, the app I'm working on for writers who can monetize their writing from day one (like Wattpad, but that pays writers).[/p][p]I have a lot of work ahead of me, so here I go![/p]

notes.title: First stable 0.6.5
notes.content: [p]Thanks everyone for coming to see my first game I made on my own: SeaCret 1![/p][p]I'm really happy.[/p][p]Since I've kept this a secret for at most the last two months, I haven't been able to do open beta testing for everyone.[/p][p]I've done a lot of testing myself with my closest loved ones, but it's possible there might be some bugs. None of them should be critical, though![/p][p]It's more likely that you don't know how some things work: The game is full of hidden features that aren't explained in the tutorial and you have to discover them yourself. Although some might be too difficult to figure out. If so, let me know, and I'll try to make it easier for those landlubbers.[/p][p]If you run into any problems or anything, please report them on the forums.[/p][p]We love you all! Thanks for joining me on this new adventure as a solo programmer of my own video games![/p]
